trades.title: Trades & small business
trades.body: 5–100 people, no bid team. Construction, facilities, IT services, staffing, supply. You have won government work before. You just miss half the chances to do it again.

certified.title: Certified suppliers
certified.body: Indigenous-, women- and veteran-owned firms. We surface the targeted and set-aside programs you are eligible for, automatically. No more guessing which door is open.

consultants.title: Consultants & bid writers
consultants.body: Run one pipeline across every client account. Find, filter and triage opportunities for all of them from a single desk.
